events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album 'Imagine' was released on October 8, 1971, in the UK (September 9, 1971, in the US).

angles.name: Timeless Message
angles.copy: 55 years ago, John Lennon gave us an anthem for peace and hope. 'Imagine' still resonates today. What's your favourite track from the album?

events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: Gordon Sumner, known as Sting, celebrates his 75th birthday on October 2, 2026.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary Sting! From The Police to his incredible solo career, what's your favourite Sting track?

events.title: The first iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple launched the original iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: Tech & Music Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? 25 years ago, the original iPod dropped and changed music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating over six decades of 007. Which Bond actor or theme song is your all-time favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon was born on October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday on October 27, 2026.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece that broke all the rules. What's your standout track?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: November 24th marks 35 years since the passing of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury in 1991.

angles.name: Legendary Voice
angles.copy: 35 years ago, we lost a true legend. Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, whose voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album 'Rubber Soul' was released on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Classic Album
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' changed the game. A pivotal album that showcased their evolving sound. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: December 8th marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: A Lasting Legacy
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, the world fell silent. Remembering John Lennon, whose music and message continue to resonate globally.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: David Bowie was born on January 8, 1947.

angles.name: Starman's 80th
angles.copy: Remembering the iconic David Bowie, who would have celebrated his 80th birthday today. A true innovator who constantly redefined music and style.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Elvis Presley was born on January 8, 1935.

angles.name: King's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy birthday to the King of Rock 'n' Roll! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today. What's your favourite Elvis hit?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday on January 9, 2027.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped rock 'n' roll forever. What's your favourite Led Zeppelin track?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Legendary singer Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday on January 10, 2027.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart! Still rocking after all these years. What's your go-to Rod song?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Graham McPherson, known as Suggs, celebrates his 66th birthday on January 13, 2027.

angles.name: Nutty Boy's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the iconic Suggs! The voice of Madness and a true British institution. What's your favourite Madness tune?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: Singer Paul Young celebrates his 71st birthday on January 17, 2027.

angles.name: 80s Pop Icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the smooth-voiced Paul Young! Still 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' is a classic. What's your favourite of his hits?
